description: VOTE Trever Nehls for Congress (CD 22) — a proven conservative leader with 33 years of military service, decades of law enforcement experience, and a career built on Service Before Self. Trever has commanded troops in combat, protected families here at home, and founded a consulting firm that helps businesses and communities solve complex problems. In Congress, he’ll fight for secure borders, safer neighborhoods, fiscal responsibility, and the Texas values that make our communities strong. On Election Day, stand with a leader who has always stood up for you — VOTE Trever Nehls for Congress.
